scenarios.name: enters-and-empowers-jace-five
scenarios.why: When it enters with no Jace token around, its trigger creates a blue Jace planeswalker token and puts five loyalty counters on it. The runner locates tokens by printed face name (the token's CR 111.4 name is 'Jace Token'), so the ref is p0:token:Token; the Jace subtype is asserted separately.

scenarios.name: minus-three-removes-three-and-draws-extra
scenarios.why: Activating the Jace token's [-3] removes three loyalty counters as its cost (5 -> 2), so Way's trigger draws a card, and the ability itself draws a card: two cards in hand.

scenarios.name: minus-one-removes-one-no-draw
scenarios.why: The [-1] removes only one loyalty counter (5 -> 4): fewer than two, so the intervening-if fails and Way never draws. The surveil itself draws nothing, so the hand stays empty. Having activated one loyalty ability of the token this turn, its [-3] is not offered again in the same main phase (CR 606.3).

scenarios.name: opponents-minus-two-does-not-draw
scenarios.why: 'Whenever YOU activate a loyalty ability': the opponent activating Liliana of the Veil's [-2] (two counters removed) on their turn does not make Way's controller draw. p0 has no cards after casting Way and draws none on p1's turn; p1's Liliana goes 3 -> 1 and p0 sacrifices its only creature.
